notes: Encoded ONLY from HydroHeat's own page. Counting convention: the page states positions in NUMERICAL digits ('3rd & 4th numerical digits' for year, '5th & 6th numerical digits' for week), so digits are counted ignoring the leading letters, per the Guardian precedent for 'numerical digits' wording. Character counting would give a different decode (year 1995, week 04) but contradicts the page's explicit 'numerical' wording and is not encoded. No month is stated, so this style ships year + week. No era dates are documented on the page, so the default yearFloor 1960 applies.

styles.notes: Page example DM 95043801, normalized DM95043801. Numerical digits in order are 9,5,0,4,3,8,0,1: 3rd & 4th numerical digits = '04' (normalized positions [4,6]) -> 2004; 5th & 6th numerical digits = '38' (normalized positions [6,8]) -> week 38. Week 38 is within 1-53, so the digit-counting reading is coherent.
